answer.formula: response ~ validity * prefill_cap * decode_cap + C(variant) + C(position_transition)

validity.formula: response ~ validity * prefill_cap * decode_cap + C(variant) + C(position_transition) + C(label_mapping)

limitations: These 24 bases are an exploratory mechanism assay, not a new confirmation set.
Bootstrap routing probabilities are sensitivity analyses around the hierarchical model.
Mechanism language requires E2B or bidirectional patching after a non-F route.
Reasoning length, answer-step telemetry, and four-state transition analyses were added after E2A completion and are post-hoc secondary analyses.

post_hoc_secondary.stratification_note: Same/changed-decision strata are descriptive post-treatment strata; families without observations in a stratum are omitted, and no causal interpretation is permitted.
